    Injective-stable covariant representables on the finite module skeleton #

    This file packages the costable functor Hom(X, -) modulo maps factoring through injectives. It is the functor-category target in the Auslander–Reiten Proposition 1.3 passage from a uniserial stable contravariant representable to a uniserial syzygy.
